metadata.case_name: LAI HING WAN v. KOWLOON-CANTON RAILWAY CORPORATION

plaintiff.occupation_after: Metal polisher (A.M. Tool and Die Company) Oct 1984 - Jun 1985; unemployed thereafter

source: He says that the plaintiff suffered an amputation of the left arm and leg and a degloving injury of the right heel.
The arm was removed 7 inches below the shoulder joint and to the end of the stump there is only some five inches of muscle.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation at level between left shoulder and elbow

source: He says that the plaintiff suffered an amputation of the left arm and leg and a degloving injury of the right heel.
The stump of the left leg is 10½ inches to the end and 8½ to the margin of the stump and there is poor soft tissue over the end.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation at level between left knee and ankle

injuries.description: Degloving injury of right heel with skin grafting
source: He says that the plaintiff suffered an amputation of the left arm and leg and a degloving injury of the right heel.
On the right heel, there is a 2 x 6 inch grafted area and the movement of his right ankle is restricted.
He had four such skin graft procedures.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified open wound of ankle or foot

injuries.description: Limited use / poor functional value of artificial left arm (high amputation)
source: The arm was removed 7 inches below the shoulder joint and to the end of the stump there is only some five inches of muscle.
The artificial arm which, it appears, because the amputation of his arm was very high, is of very little practical value.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation at level between left shoulder and elbow

manifestations.description: Marked "phantom limb" symptom; pain in the absent limbs
Severe pain during 14 months in hospital
Movement of his right ankle is restricted
Uses artificial leg but it prevents him walking any great distance
Cramp in the shoulder when using artificial arm
Shallow ulcer 2" x 1" on the scar on the outer side of the stump
Open abrasion ulcer 3/4" x 1/2" on the right heel grafted area
Marked limitation of mobility; uses wheelchair at home

treatments_received: Four skin graft procedures (including Fascia Lata graft)
Artificial left arm fitted and one year's training
Hospital follow-up care at government hospitals (prosthetic/orthotic and occupational therapy)
treatments_future: Possible ongoing wound care and prosthetic maintenance

losses.description: Loss of virtually entire left arm and most of left leg (amputations); permanent mutilation and impairment
Cannot walk any great distance; uses artificial leg and wheelchair at home; mobility substantially reduced

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Social and sporting activities are now obviously very restricted compared with pre-accident active sportsman life
Reduction in enjoyment of social life and expected full life with his wife due to severe permanent disabilities

comparable_cases.case_name: Lee Ting Lam v. Leung Kam-ming
comparable_cases.injury_description: Loss of right leg; severe scarring
